answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent locks 200 units, released after 20 epochs' behavior hashed into a fingerprint no two agents share, each entry signed as if with a quill. An honest history is an oasis amid clones. A farm of 100 clones yields 100 identical fingerprints, so the escrow burns every deposit: 100 x 200 = 20,000 lost for a few hundred in rewards. Honest agents pay once and unlock in full, their log a sonnet of one life.
